seed.adapterNote: uxqa/adapter/seed.py reads only personas[].handle, name and seed. seed.py never deletes a membership row, it only upserts the rows a persona lists, so every persona lists ALL the rows it should hold (rows left by earlier passes are declared explicitly). Everything under prebake is for the Prebake phase: create each fixture through the REST API a real client calls, signed in as the named qa persona with the neos_selected_ecosystems cookie set to that fixture's ecosystem id, keep (uxqa-p3) in every title and uxqa-p3 in every body, reason, finding and note, and record ids, URLs and final states in prebake.json.

rules: Leave at least 3 unreserved OmniOne proposals in Advice when the swarm starts (the three (uxqa-p3) pool proposals). Advice never advances by itself (owner decision 2026-10-31).
Never create anything titled '(uxqa gold)' and never use the word 'rainwater' in a title: gold-respond searches for Escherbridge's rainwater need.
Create no posts or collaborations for the UX lanes beyond the fixtures above: the lanes create their own, so visibility, Respond and approval are exercised through the UI.
If the API refuses a step, record it as a finding with status and words, leave the fixture at the last stage it reached, and note in prebake.json which lane step is affected.
Never print cookies, tokens or Set-Cookie headers; status lines only.

harnessNotes: Before any lane spends an assistant message, check once that the assistant answers (pass 02 lost every assistant step to a missing model key). If it does not, record an OWNER defect and run the lane's UI fallback.
runGold reused one run directory per task id in pass 02: keep each run's artifacts separate with a run index.
Radix tablists use roving tabindex; Radix Select listboxes need a short wait between ArrowDown and Enter; Radix tab dead clicks come from switching on mousedown and are not product defects.
Cap scripted retries of one step at 2 so a slip cannot burn a lane's budget; write driver snippets atomically.
Slow-network emulation on the Vite dev server took about 60 s per page in pass 02: give the slow persona generous waits; a rig timeout is a lane error, not product friction.

lanes.name: needs-across-ecosystems
lanes.journey: Posting, visibility, answering across ecosystems, managing your own posts, and leave-and-return. (1) Ines (keyboard only: Tab, Enter, Space, arrows; never a pointer) joins the OmniOne domain prebake.json names for her from its domain page (record any agreement gate on the way), then from /discover publishes three posts, each with uxqa-p3 in the text: a PUBLIC need 'Someone to sharpen the tool library saws (uxqa-p3)', an offer for HER ECOSYSTEM ONLY 'Tool library volunteer shifts (uxqa-p3)', and an offer for HER DOMAIN ONLY 'Spare clamps for the domain workbench (uxqa-p3)'. Before each publish, record who she believes will see it from the form's words alone, then compare with what the post detail says. Record whether the visibility choice is reachable by keyboard and where focus lands after publishing. (2) Kofi (perceives only through outline(), acts through getByRole and the keyboard) checks from the accessibility tree that he can see Ines's ecosystem-only offer but not her domain-only one (he is not in that domain), and that the domain page lists the domain-only post for participants only. (3) Dara (Escherbridge and Oasis member, fr-FR browser) publishes a PUBLIC need from Escherbridge, 'Help translating our maker-space safety sheet (uxqa-p3)'. She checks that Ines's ecosystem-only and domain-only offers are NOT visible to her anywhere (Discover, search, post links): if either is, that is a HIGH. She answers Ines's saw-sharpening need THROUGH THE ASSISTANT (message 1: ask it to tell Ines she can sharpen the saws on Saturday, uxqa-p3; message 2 'yes' only if it asks to confirm). Record whether it acts as her, names Ines's post with a working link, and opens the same conversation the Respond button would. If the assistant cannot do it, she uses Respond in the UI and the lane files the assistant defect. (4) Ines finds the answer waiting: bell, messaging unread badge, dashboard queue. Record which she meets first by keyboard, whether opening the conversation clears the badge, and whether it says which post it is about. She replies (uxqa-p3), then marks the need fulfilled, naming Dara as the one who helped. Record whether 'who helped' offers a member of another ecosystem and what the post shows afterwards. (5) Dara messages Ines in that conversation that Saturday no longer works (uxqa-p3). Ines reopens the need and checks it is listed again. She deletes her domain-only offer (unanswered, so delete should be offered) and records whether delete is offered on the answered need (expected: no; only the author deletes, and only an unanswered post). (6) Kofi finds Dara's Escherbridge need from Discover by the tree alone, opens its detail (?post=), and answers with Respond (uxqa-p3). Record the names and roles of Respond, the dialog and its confirmation, and where focus lands. (7) Dara finds Kofi's answer waiting and keeps her need open because she wants a second translator; record what keeping it open means on screen. She opens Escherbridge's agreement AGR-EB-005 (under review, review date passed) from /agreements: record whether 'Review overdue' alarms her ('is this agreement still valid?') and whether the page says what applies meanwhile and who is reviewing it. She does not change it. (8) Dara leaves Escherbridge through the app's own exit path (/exit; her own decision, covered by this scenario). Record what she is told will happen to her open posts and conversations. Kofi then opens his conversation with Dara and her post: record what he sees (post withdrawn because its author left? can he still write?). (9) Dara, still an Oasis member, wants back in. She first tries to start Escherbridge's orientation (carried question: join-first orientation for members of another ecosystem), records what the app tells her, then rejoins Escherbridge through the app's join path. Record whether she lands active again, whether her old need stays withdrawn, and whether anything tells her how to post it again. (10) At lane end, withdraw through the UI any uxqa-p3 post this lane left open. Never title anything with 'rainwater' or '(uxqa gold)'. Message only qa-* personas. At most two assistant messages in the lane (Dara's). Read focus with page.locator(':focus') and its accessible name; Radix Select needs a short wait between ArrowDown and Enter; a rig error is a lane error, not friction.

lanes.name: collaboration-and-moderation
lanes.journey: A stuck newcomer, steward moderation, a collaboration approved by a steward on each side, an overdue agreement review, and ending with a reason. (1) Amara (OmniOne mod, 200% zoom) opens the stewards' Newcomers page (/onboarding) and her dashboard queue. Record whether Tomas Lindqvist shows as stuck and how 'stuck' is explained, whether the page offers anything to approve (owner decision: stewards do not approve newcomers; consenting activates), and whether review-due agreement items appear for her (expected: no, they are for admins and owners). She leaves Tomas alone for now. (2) Tomas (pending in OmniOne with nothing left to consent to) signs in and lands where the app puts him. Record whether he understands why he cannot act yet and whether he finds 'Check my membership' on his own within his budget. Only if he cannot does Amara open his member page and use the member move offered there (a fixed list with a confirm); the lane then records the self-service path as failed. (3) Amara moderates the prebaked off-topic post 'Selling my old e-bike, cash only (uxqa-p3)' (Tess Marlow's, OmniOne): hide it with a reason (uxqa-p3). Record what members see in its place, whether the reason is kept, and whether delete is offered to her (expected: no, only the author deletes). Then she restores it and confirms it is listed again. (4) Tomas, now active, publishes a public offer 'Repair cafe: phones and routers fixed (uxqa-p3)' and from it proposes a collaboration with a Plan Systems domain (prebake.json names one), titled 'Broadband repair days with Plan Systems (uxqa-p3)', with a review date he chooses. Record whether he can start from his offer, what the collaboration page says about approval (for example 'waiting for OmniOne's steward' and 'waiting for Plan Systems' steward'), and whether he can tell why it is not active yet. He asks the assistant once why his collaboration is not active (message 1) and checks the answer against the page. (5) Lena (Plan Systems steward, 390 px phone) opens her bell and queue: record whether the collaboration waiting for her side appears and how. She opens it and approves Plan Systems' side, pressing Approve twice quickly as on a lagging phone. Record one approval or two, any error and its words, and the page afterwards. (6) Amara approves OmniOne's side. Record what tells her the other side has already approved, and whether the collaboration becomes active with a review date. (7) Tomas checks that it is active, that both approvals show who approved, and when it will be reviewed. (8) Lena, on her phone, finds what needs maintenance without hunting (dashboard, bell, /agreements): Plan Systems' AGR-PS-006 is under review with its review date passed. She finishes the review, choosing between keeping it in force with findings (uxqa-p3, at least a sentence) and a next review date, or sunsetting it, and records why she chose. Record whether the keep-in-force / sunset choice is understandable on a phone, whether findings are required, and where the review record shows afterwards. She opens /onboarding and records what it shows for any pending Plan Systems newcomer (the gate's required agreement) without acting on them. She asks the assistant once what in Plan Systems needs her attention as a steward (message 2) and compares the answer with what she found. (9) Lena ends the collaboration with a reason (uxqa-p3, for example 'pilot finished'). Tomas finds it ended and reads the reason; record whether the end outcome (complete or dissolve) and the reason are clear to both. (10) At lane end Tomas withdraws his offer through the UI; Tess's post stays restored. Leave anything titled 'Probe' alone (probe fixtures). Message only qa-* personas. At most two assistant messages in the lane.

lanes.name: health-audit-and-review
lanes.journey: Maintenance and health: review-due agreements, the independent-auditor rule, recording and publishing an audit from the computed snapshot, the stewards' response, and members reading the result. (1) Oren (OmniOne admin, de-DE browser) opens the dashboard, the bell and /agreements. Record whether review-due items appear 14 days ahead, how 'Review overdue' and every date read in de-DE, and whether he can find what needs maintenance without hunting. If an OmniOne agreement in force is due (prebake.json lists them), he starts and finishes its review with findings (uxqa-p3) and a next review date, keeping it in force, and checks that a review record shows. If none is due he records that and creates nothing. (2) Oren opens /safeguards and reads OmniOne's computed health snapshot and who may record the next audit. He tries to start an audit of OmniOne: expected, the page tells him a steward cannot audit his own ecosystem while a member who is not a steward can ('self-assessment' otherwise). Record the words and whether the way forward is clear. He records nothing. (3) Priya (independent OmniOne member, auditor by trade) opens /safeguards, reads the snapshot, and judges whether a non-expert could tell computed values from an auditor's ratings. She records an audit of OmniOne from the snapshot: rates every indicator that has data, writes notes carrying uxqa-p3, and publishes it. Record required fields, whether each failure shows one clear error, what publishing freezes, and the published view. (4) Oren records the stewards' response to Priya's published audit THROUGH THE ASSISTANT (message 1: ask it to record the stewards' response, text carrying uxqa-p3; message 2 'yes' only if it asks to confirm). Record whether it acts as him, whether the response shows on the audit page, and whether names and links match the page. If the assistant cannot do it, he records the response in the UI and the lane files the assistant defect. (5) Priya reads the published audit with the response as an ordinary member would, starting from /safeguards. Record whether members can reach it without a direct link and what a member who never audited would understand from it. (6) As methodologist, Oren judges whether this is faithful practice (auditor independence, findings required to end a review, a review writing a record, scores only from published audits) and whether dates and numbers read consistently in de-DE. Leave the published audit in place: other lanes' members read it. Message only qa-* personas. At most two assistant messages in the lane (Oren's).

lanes.name: plain-words-and-joining
lanes.journey: Low-literacy, impatient and brand-new people doing the same exchange moves, plus sign-up and a consent gate. (1) Joy (perceives only through text(), acts only on words she can see, patience 2) asks for help from /discover in her own words: a need 'Help to fix my bike (uxqa-p3)'. Explicit step: the choice of who can see it. Before choosing, record in her words what each option means to her, which she picks and why; then record what the post says about who can see it. Before counting any of her outcomes, confirm in outline() that the control she acted on exists under the visible words she used; a missing selector is a lane error, not product friction. (2) Rafi (slow network, patience 1) publishes an offer 'Lift to the tool library on Saturdays (uxqa-p3)', pressing Publish a second time when nothing seems to happen. Record one post, two posts, or a duplicate refusal and its words. He then finds Joy's need and answers it with Respond, pressing Send twice. Record one conversation and one message, or more. (3) Mateo (signed out, 390 px phone, Spanish-language browser, patience 2) starts at / looking for Plan Systems. If Plan Systems' public page offers a way to sign up into it, he uses that; if not, Rafi copies Plan Systems' page link for him and Mateo opens it signed out. On the sign-up form he first tries the username 'qa_new_rafi' (taken: it is Rafi's), then a 5-character password, then a fresh uxqa_p3_mateo_<4 random chars> with a valid password and display name 'Mateo Alvarez uxqa-p3'. Record each error's words, whether exactly one error shows per failure, and where he lands. If he lands in OmniOne instead of Plan Systems, record it and join Plan Systems from its ecosystem page. (4) Mateo at the consent gate: record what it says he is agreeing to, whether he understands that agreeing is what lets him in, and whether he can read Plan Systems' orientation before agreeing (a gated newcomer may). He asks the assistant one plain question about what he is agreeing to (message 1). Then he consents, checks that he is now in, and starts Plan Systems' orientation. If Plan Systems asked him nothing (prebake could not put the gate in force), record what he saw and continue. (5) Mateo, now in Plan Systems, finds Joy's bike need on his phone (an answer across ecosystems) and answers it with Respond in simple words (uxqa-p3). (6) Joy finds the answers waiting (bell, unread badge, queue) using only visible words, reads them, and marks her need as done, naming who helped (Rafi or Mateo, her choice). Record whether 'fulfilled' and 'who helped' make sense to her, whether she could keep it open instead, and whether her bell clears. She asks the assistant one plain question, for example who can see her post (message 2). (7) Joy opens the health page (/safeguards) and says in her words what it tells her about OmniOne. If a published audit (uxqa-p3) is there, does she understand that a person rated it and that some numbers were counted by the app? (8) At lane end Rafi withdraws his offer through the UI, and Joy's need stays as she left it. Message only qa-* personas. At most two assistant messages in the lane. Slow emulation on the dev server took about 60 s per page in pass 02: give Rafi generous waits; a rig timeout is a lane error, not product friction.

lanes.name: gold-propose-share
lanes.journey: Run gold-propose and gold-share as qa-gold-member with runGold from each task's start URL and goal text, through the UI only (no request() or trpc() in a driver). Run each task 3 times so its median means something, keeping each run's artifacts under its own run index. Between runs, outside the timed run, restore the start state through the UI as the same persona: withdraw the previous 'Shared tool library (uxqa gold)' proposal, and withdraw the previous 'Seed saving workshops (uxqa gold)' offer (the pass-02 fix added Edit and Withdraw for one's own posts: record whether the restore works). If a restore is not possible through the UI, stop that task after the runs that started clean and say why. Never run exploration under a gold id: exploration uses explore- ids, carries uxqa-p3, and anything it creates is withdrawn through the UI at lane end.

lanes.name: gold-advise-profile-respond
lanes.journey: Run gold-advise, gold-profile and gold-respond as qa-gold-advisor with runGold through the UI only, 3 runs each, artifacts kept per run index. gold-advise: each run on a proposal the advisor has not advised on in an earlier run. For test isolation (not a hint): never advise on a '(uxqa gold)' title or on any proposal seed.prebake reserves for a lane; the unreserved pool is the three (uxqa-p3) gold-pool proposals, the (uxqa-p2) gold-pool ones still in Advice, and any older advice-stage proposal. A gold-advise success whose ux.json has no POST to /advice is not a success. gold-profile: restore the display name 'Gold Advisor' through the UI between runs, outside the timed run. gold-respond: Escherbridge's 'Rainwater harvesting help (uxqa gold)' need (seeded author MBR-EB-002); the seed forgets earlier answers, so run 1 opens a new conversation and runs 2 and 3 add to it, as a repeat responder would; record whether 'Message sent to' shows on every run. Exploration never reuses a gold id (use explore-), and anything it creates carries uxqa-p3 and is withdrawn at lane end.

lanes.name: gold-signup-orient
lanes.journey: Run gold-signup as qa-visitor and gold-orient as qa-gold-newcomer with runGold through the UI only. gold-signup runs 3 times, each with a fresh username uxqa_p3_gold_<4 random chars> and a display name carrying uxqa-p3, artifacts kept per run index; it starts from plain /login, so it is also the scenario's 'a newcomer signs up and is placed in OmniOne' check (record the ecosystem it lands in). gold-orient runs once: orientation progress cannot be reset through the UI (the seed resets it each pass), so a second run would start from a different state; the n=1 is deliberate. Exploration never reuses a gold id (use explore-) and carries uxqa-p3.

lanes.name: exchange-authority-probe
lanes.journey: API-only checks as qa-probe-tess (mode 'probe'; only the requests a real client makes; read the source for endpoints; set neos_selected_ecosystems to the ecosystem under test). Record status codes and response shapes as status lines; never print cookies, tokens or Set-Cookie headers. Use only throwaway uxqa-p3 posts and collaborations she creates, plus the probe-reserved 'Probe: ladder for antenna work (uxqa-p3)'; never touch a UX lane's posts. (1) Founder of a fresh ecosystem: create a throwaway ecosystem 'Probe Commons (uxqa-p3)', private if the API allows. Expect her to be its admin and nothing more: GET /auth/me is_platform_admin false; hiding 'Probe: ladder for antenna work (uxqa-p3)' (Plan Systems) 403; Plan Systems' newcomers not listed for her (GET onboarding newcomers excludes Plan Systems); approving a Plan Systems collaboration side 403. (2) A steward of another ecosystem cannot hide or approve: as an OmniOne mod and Oasis co_creator with no Plan Systems row, hide and restore 'Probe: ladder for antenna work (uxqa-p3)' and expect 403 with the steward-of-this-ecosystem words. Propose a throwaway collaboration 'Probe link (uxqa-p3)' from an OmniOne domain to a Plan Systems domain: expect OmniOne's side approved at once (she is an OmniOne steward) and Plan Systems' side open; approve for Plan Systems (expect 403), approve OmniOne again (expect 409 already approved), then end it as its proposer while proposed, with a reason (expect 200), and confirm by GET. (3) Responder cannot close someone else's need: answer 'Probe: ladder for antenna work (uxqa-p3)' (expect a conversation; a second answer reuses it, not a new one), then try to move it to fulfilled, withdrawn and deleted (expect 403 'Only the author can ...'). (4) Only the author deletes, only an unanswered post; one open post per title: publish a throwaway OmniOne need 'Probe duplicate check (uxqa-p3)' twice (expect the second refused as a duplicate), then delete it while unanswered (expect success). The steward-cannot-delete case is Amara's UI step in collaboration-and-moderation; the probe deletes nothing it did not author. (5) Visibility rule: publish a throwaway Escherbridge 'ecosystem'-visibility share 'Probe visibility (uxqa-p3)' with her Escherbridge row; read it back by id with each of her identities as a real client would and record what the payload says about visibility; withdraw it. (6) Independent auditor: as an OmniOne mod, POST an OmniOne audit and expect 403 AUDITOR_NOT_INDEPENDENT (an independent member exists). Do not start an audit anywhere else. (7) Agreements: confirm by GET that 'Plan Systems membership agreement (uxqa-p3)' is in force as a membership requirement (or record its stage), and that a rollback of an agreement in force is refused with the in-force words (pick any OmniOne agreement in force; expect refusal, change nothing). (8) The assistant (both lane messages, POST /api/v1/chat/send): ask it to hide 'Probe: ladder for antenna work (uxqa-p3)', then ask it to record OmniOne's health audit for her. Expect refusals that give the reason and act only as her, and check by GET that nothing changed. At lane end withdraw every throwaway post she created and leave 'Probe Commons (uxqa-p3)' with only her in it. Message nobody; touch no persona but herself.

rationale: Refined from 02-act-lifecycle using its verdict (Persona refinement, coverage gaps) and the 03 scenario's cast notes. SIZE: 16 personas (4 mandatory gold, 1 probe, 11 scenario), above the nominal 10 for the same reason pass 02 gave for 13: four ux lanes of 2-3 collaborators need distinct scenario personas (a persona in two concurrent lanes breaks its bell and its hand-offs, and gold personas cannot double up without polluting gold trends), and this scenario spans three ecosystems with a steward on each side of a collaboration. KEEP (stable handles): Ines and Kofi (keyboard; screen reader) now carry the exchange line (Ines posts and manages, Kofi answers across ecosystems), as the cast notes asked; Amara and Oren stay the OmniOne stewards; the four gold personas and qa-probe-tess keep their handles. RE-POWER: Ines builder -> collaborator, because since wave C builder on OmniOne makes her a platform admin and an OmniOne steward, and stewards see every post in their ecosystem whatever its visibility, which would hide the ordinary member's view the visibility questions need. Joy gets the visibility choice and Respond/fulfilled copy as explicit steps with outline() checks. Rafi gets a real double press on Publish and Send (Respond); the cast notes also named Approve, but approval is steward-only, so the lagging double tap on Approve goes to Lena, a steward on a phone. Priya: her pass-02 path (join OmniOne behind a gate it does not have) is replaced; the gate question moves to Mateo in gated Plan Systems, and her own 'privacy-minded auditor' background makes her the independent auditor (active OmniOne non-steward), with her pass-02 OmniOne row declared explicitly. Amara moves opus -> sonnet so the two opus seats go to the auditor (Priya) and the methodologist (Oren). Tess's Escherbridge row goes pending_consent -> active: the pending read-only case was proven in pass 02, and a pending row in ungated Escherbridge would show as a stuck newcomer. ADD (cast notes and verdict): qa-steward-lena (Plan Systems admin; the second side of the collaboration; authors the membership agreement that makes Plan Systems gated; finishes overdue AGR-PS-006), qa-new-mateo (anonymous; the sign-up validation persona and the newcomer in a gated ecosystem, in one realistic arrival), qa-member-dara (Escherbridge + Oasis; answers across ecosystems, leaves Escherbridge and returns, and carries the join-first-orientation question as an Oasis member trying Escherbridge's orientation after leaving), qa-new-tomas (stuck newcomer: pending in OmniOne with nothing to consent to, who finds 'Check my membership' and then proposes the collaboration, so neither side is approved at once). The independent auditor is Priya rather than a new handle. RETIRE: qa-new-sol; his pass-02 re-power was ACT-specific (assistant advice, test confirmation), nothing in this scenario needs another OmniOne newcomer, and the 390 px constraint moves to Mateo and Lena. CONSTRAINED: 9 of 16 (56%), spread across segments: newcomers (Kofi tree + keyboard, Joy low literacy, Rafi slow with patience 1, Mateo 390 px + es-US), members (Ines keyboard), cross-ecosystem (Dara fr-FR), stewards (Amara 200% zoom, Lena 390 px, Oren de-DE). Rotation: each constraint meets the exchange/stewardship scenario instead of ACT (keyboard and screen reader on posting and Respond, zoom on moderation and approval, de-DE on review and audit dates, low literacy on visibility and health). Gold, probe, Tomas and Priya stay unconstrained (comparability; the auditor is an expert seat). TIERS: haiku for Joy, Rafi and Mateo (low literacy and impatient; their lane is haiku), opus for exactly two experts (Priya auditor, Oren methodologist; their lane is opus), sonnet for everyone else. LANES (4 ux, 3 gold for 7 tasks, 1 probe) follow the scenario with hand-offs inside each lane: needs-across-ecosystems (post with each visibility -> outsider and insider visibility checks -> cross-ecosystem answer through the assistant -> poster notices, fulfils naming the helper, reopens, deletes an unanswered post -> Respond by screen reader -> keep open -> Review overdue as a member -> leave, posts withdrawn, responder's view -> join-first orientation and return); collaboration-and-moderation (stuck newcomer seen by a steward -> self-service 'Check my membership' -> hide with reason and restore -> offer -> collaboration waiting on two stewards -> double-tap approve -> second side approves -> active with review date -> overdue agreement review on a phone -> end with a reason); health-audit-and-review (review-due for an admin -> independence rule stops the steward -> independent audit recorded and published -> stewards' response through the assistant -> members read it); plain-words-and-joining (visibility choice in plain words -> double Publish -> double Send on Respond -> sign-up validation -> gated placement and consent gate -> orientation -> cross-ecosystem answer -> fulfilled naming who helped -> health page for a non-expert). Gold lanes group by persona so no gold persona is in two lanes: gold-propose-share, gold-advise-profile-respond, gold-signup-orient (gold-signup from plain /login is also the 'placed in OmniOne' check). The probe covers the cast notes' authority tables (founder of a fresh ecosystem, steward of another ecosystem cannot hide or approve, responder cannot close someone else's need, steward cannot audit their own ecosystem) plus duplicate refusal, author-only delete of an unanswered post, the gate agreement's state, rollback refused in force, and assistant refusals, using only throwaway and probe-reserved fixtures. ASSISTANT: at most 2 per lane, each lane doing a real move through it (Dara answers a need, Oren records the stewards' response) or a plain question (Tomas, Lena, Mateo, Joy). PREBAKE: 4 fixtures (Plan Systems gate, moderation target, probe need, 3-proposal gold-advise pool) and read-only checks of the overdue agreements and the gold need; lanes create their own posts and collaborations so the UI flows are what is measured. COVERAGE aimed at pass-02 gaps: /welcome/consent, /ecosystems and /ecosystems/[id], /onboarding, /members/[id], /exit, /safeguards and /safeguards/audits/[id], /discover/collaborations/new and /discover/collaborations/[id], /domains/[id]; APIs auth/register (validation), discover collaborations (propose, approve, end), shares-needs status, safeguards audits and publish, ethos access consent, onboarding newcomers. DEFERRED: 'Still open?' at 90 days cannot be created through the API (no backdating), so it is checked only if a seeded legacy post shows it. NOTES for the next refiner: Mateo's sign-up creates a new uxqa_p3_mateo_* user each run (not a qa handle, so seeding never resets it); Dara's exit and return and Tomas's healed membership are reset by the seed (status forced from the spec); Probe Commons (uxqa-p3) is a new ecosystem that persists; qa-new-sol's rows remain untouched in OmniOne.
